tickets.title: Task Count by Status
tickets.description: Create a report showing each `status` and the total number of tasks in that status.
tasks: Create a report showing each `status` and the total number of tasks in that status.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.

solution.query.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS task_count FROM todos GROUP BY status;

tickets.title: Overloaded Users
tickets.description: Show the `user_id` and count of tasks only for users who have strictly more than 5 tasks.
tasks: Show the `user_id` and count of tasks only for users who have strictly more than 5 tasks.
tickets.evaluation: Runs your query and compares against the system solution.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the semicolon at the end of the query.
Using double quotes instead of single quotes for strings.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

solution.query.sql:
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS total_tasks 
FROM todos 
GROUP BY user_id 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
